summary: Iteration 15 verified end-to-end: Stripe checkout metadata persistence, supabase_admin module safety, AnnouncementBanner (ES/EN copy + dismiss + persistence + click-through), sticky Navbar, language switcher regression, PaymentReturnModal client-side supabase UPDATE removed, all 13 sections render. Backend 7/7 pytest passing, frontend 9/9 critical assertions passing, no JS pageerrors. UpgradeScreen + PlatformAccessScreen 'redirect' fresh-purchase branch verified by code review only (cannot complete a real Stripe checkout in test env, per agent_to_agent_context_note).
critical_code_review_comments: supabase_admin.py uses a module-level singleton _client and reads SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY at import time. If a future test or runtime mutates env vars after import, get_admin_client() will not pick them up without an importlib.reload. Acceptable for production but worth documenting.

server.py /api/stripe/checkout-status and /api/webhook/stripe both call update_profile_plan synchronously inside an async route. Since supabase-py is sync, a slow Supabase response would block the event loop briefly. Consider running update_profile_plan via asyncio.to_thread/run_in_executor for hot paths.
PaymentReturnModal.continueToPlatform calls clearIntent() before navigating; if the redirect fails the user loses the resume context. Minor — keep an eye on it.
UpgradeScreen DiffPill 'currentLabel' falls back to PLAN_LIMITS[current]?.label which is 'Starter' for essential — consistent with PlatformAccessScreen mapping. Good.

PlatformAccessScreen redirect-stage fresh detection uses Date.now() - new Date(profile.plan_updated_at).getTime() < 6*60*1000 — solid; clock skew between server (Supabase) and browser could make age negative on edge cases, already guarded by `age >= 0`.

The supabase_admin env-missing test mutates env via monkeypatch and reload — restored at end. Language switcher selector is data-testid='lang-toggle-en' / 'lang-toggle-es' (NOT 'lang-en').
